# Jeanette Silvas

Design engineer based in Seattle. Working across Figma and React — currently at Amazon on the Product Image Experience team.

## About

I work on both sides of the design-engineering gap. At Amazon that's meant owning high-impact features end-to-end: Figma explorations, frontend spec, and React + TypeScript implementation.

Background: AWS, InVision, Expedia. Degree in Bioengineering from Texas A&M.

## Work

- **Bulk Image Upload** (Amazon, 2024–2025) — Redesigned the bulk image upload flow. Cut support tickets by 20%.
- **Image Manager** (Amazon, 2026) — Redesigned a years-old fixed layout to be responsive. More images visible at once, collapsible country sections, and a country filter for large international catalogs. A/B tested; neutral on conversion, positive on page engagement.

## Stack

React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Figma
